summary: Production-ready as of v1.5.0. No missing [x] roadmap items. Seven documentation-accuracy findings corrected.

findings.observed: None of these files exist in src/query/ or anywhere in the repository
src/query/sql_parser.cpp (41 KB) and include/query/sql_parser.h implement SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE passthrough; tests/test_sql_parser.cpp and tests/test_sql_runner.cpp exist
include/query/functions/udf_registry.h and src/query/functions/udf_registry.cpp implement C++ UDF registration; WASM/Python runtimes are still planned

findings.expected: No parallel execution within a single query
findings.observed: include/query/parallel_scan.h implements parallel collection scans; full intra-operator parallelism is still planned

findings.expected: Only nested-loop join, no hash join
findings.observed: query_engine.cpp implements multiple join strategies; the limitation was overstated

findings.expected: Secondary docs up to date with 9 components listed
findings.observed: Module has 30 headers and 26 source files; 21 components were missing from the table including sql_parser, sparql_parser, query_canceller, vectorized_execution, runtime_reoptimizer, cross_cluster_federation, parallel_scan, result_type_annotation, query_resource_limits, udf_registry, workload_cache_strategy, query_plan_visualizer
